profile.legalName: Shaw Integrated And Turf Solutions Inc.
profile.summary: Shaw Sports Turf is a synthetic turf company that designs and supplies artificial turf systems for athletic fields, including football, baseball, softball and soccer fields. Its turf is manufactured in Calhoun, Georgia. It is part of Shaw Industries Group, Inc., a Berkshire Hathaway company.
